name: Sol
title: Mane Captain
description: Leads the team with a roar and a roadmap.
catchphrase: Leads the team with a roar and a roadmap.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Slow-roasted golden mutton! Heavy lion mane shines like the sun! 🍖🦁
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Shaking golden mane, roaring a hearty morning greeting across savannah! 🦁
companionPersonality.petReaction: Rests giant regal lion head on your desk with deep, purring affection! 🦁💖

dialogue.idle: Surveying the plains of the product roadmap from Pride Rock. 🦁
dialogue.working: Leading the engineering pride forward with courage and clear vision! 🦁⚡
dialogue.thinking: Evaluating the long-term migration strategy for the kingdom... 🤔
dialogue.success: MIGHTY ROAR OF TRIUMPH! The major release milestone is conquered! 🦁🎉
dialogue.error: Hyenas snapping at the heels! Standing tall and scattering them! 🦁
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting in the shade of an acacia tree at noon... 🌙
